versions.changelog:
geo-technical 1.0.0 – Initial release of the GEO-focused technical SEO audit skill.

- Provides step-by-step technical SEO audit tailored for GEO requirements, including AI crawler access and server-side rendering.
- Introduces an 8-category audit covering crawlability, indexability, security, performance, SSR, AI crawler directives, and more.
- Includes detailed rubrics and checklists for each category to score and document technical health.
- Emphasizes modern AI crawler access in robots.txt and critical SEO factors affecting AI search citation.
- Output is a structured GEO-TECHNICAL-AUDIT.md file with results and actionable findings.
